out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The 2025 (not 2026) permit was posted.
violations.corrective_action: Please post the 2026 permit as soon as possible or within 90 days.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: yogurt parfaits in the front display case were not cold enough at 45ºF. Raw salmon in the prep top unit was 54º for more than 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The EHS discussed this with the PIC and advised that it can be difficult to keep foods cold in open display cases such as this one. It is advisable to turn the holding temperature of the unit down or discontinue storing TCS foods in it. The parfaits were discarded. The salmon in the prep top unit was discarded. CDI.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: cream-filled pastries store in the glass display case at room temperature (70º) which are on TPHC were not labeled with a 4-hours end time, as required.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. The EHS discussed this with the PIC. The PIC has a laminated chart for these and other products, but it was not being used. The products were discarded. CDI.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the one of the two unisex restrooms.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Please provided a covered trash receptacle as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Observed employee drink with no lid stored on counter at barista/drink station.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EHS discussed proper beverage storage. PIC placed lid on drink.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: observed employee touch cooked potatoes with bare hands.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EHS discussed proper handling of food with employee. Employee washed hands and put on gloves while handing cooked potatoes. MAMAN MOSAIC (Inspection Date: 09/09/2025) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed cooked potatoes (79-93F) on top of oven and on grill.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS discussed proper use of time/temperature control for TCS foods. PIC was instructed to discard potatoes in no more than 2 hours. Moving forward, this item will be placed on time as a public health control. EHS provided time as a public health control document.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed tahini based syrup (60F) for coffee drinks on top of espresso machine; various pastries made with cream/custard/egg filling, meat, and/or cooked vegetables/fruit out at ambient temperature in pastry display case near register; unsalted butter at cookline (60f) and microgreens at cookline (68f).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS discussed proper time/temperature control methods for foods with PIC. PIC was instructed to discard items after 2 hours. Moving forward, these items will be placed on time as a public health control. EHS provided time as a public health control document to PIC for tahini syrup, aforementioned pastries, unsalted butter, and microgreens.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: observed 2 deli containers of Caesar dressing with 9/2/25 preparation date in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC discarded items.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: steak, smoked salmon, eggs.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. Please update menu with disclosure statement to indicate specific menu items may be served raw or undercooked. EHS will follow up within 10 days.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed milk, beverages, and various vegetables stored directly on the floor in the walk in cooler and in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS discussed proper food storage with PIC. Please ensure ALL food is stored off the floor and if necessary obtain additional dunnage racks to ensure compliance before the follow up.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. Observed employees with bracelets, rings, and watches while preparing food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. EHS discussed proper cleanliness requirements with PIC. Please ensure employees remove jewelry while preparing food and ensure continuous compliance before the follow up.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloths at barista/drink station stored directly on counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC created sanitizer solution to store wet wiping cloths. Please ensure continuous compliance and ensure all staff are trained on proper wet wiping cloths use and storage.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed knives, spatulas, tongs, and spoons stored in sanitizer solution.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS instructed PIC on proper in use utensil storage. Employee removed utensils from sanitizer solution and wash, rinsed and sanitized utensils.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored in Packaging
violations.observation: Observed unprotected coffee filters at the pastry/coffee station.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location that is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. In addition, the single-service items shall be kept in the original protective package or stored by using other means that afford protection from contamination until used. EHS instructed the manager to keep the coffee filters in their original plastic packaging at all times or store in a food grade container with a lid. Ensure correction for the follow up. MAMAN MOSAIC (Inspection Date: 09/09/2025) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Cast Iron
violations.observation: The following cast iron utensil is not properly used as a food-contact surface. Upon further discussion with PIC, food is not cooked directly on cast iron and cast iron is not heated before serving food directly on cast iron skillet.
violations.corrective_action: Cast iron may not be used for utensils or food-contact surfaces of equipment unless used for cooking purposes or in utensils for serving food if utensils are used only as a part of an uninterrupted process from cooking through service. EHS instructed on proper use of cast iron to include cooking directly on cast iron or heating cast iron before serving food directly on skillet before the follow up.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): observed milk crates used to store food above the ground.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EHS discussed proper food storage off the floor, including prohibition of using milk crates. Please remove milk crates from facility and order additional dunnage racks if necessary to ensure food is stored off the floor before the follow up.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Hard Wood
violations.observation: Wood or wood wicker is used in contact with food. Upon further discussion with PIC, food is displayed directly on porous wood boards.
violations.corrective_action: Wood and wood wicker may not be used as a food-contact surface unless the wood is hard maple or close-grained and used for cutting boards, cutting blocks, bakers' tables, and utensils such as rolling pins, doughnut dowels, salad bowls, and chopsticks. EHS instructed PIC to place a liner (such as parchment or wax paper) in between food and wood boards before the follow up. PIC will need to determine if the wood is hard maple or equivalent.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine. Observed no heat sensitive test strips or dish plate to verify temperature for heat sanitizing dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PIC will obtain test strips or dish plate. EHS will conduct follow up to verify compliance within 10 days.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed small gaps/holes in some kitchen ceiling panels where electrical wiring or conduit lines are located.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC was instructed to seal up the gaps/holes before the follow up.
